# Priya Nair

## Summary
Backend engineer with 6 years building distributed systems, focused on Kubernetes-based infrastructure and event-driven architectures.

## Experience

### Senior Software Engineer, Acme Robotics (2022-Present)
Led the migration of a monolithic order-processing service to a container orchestration pipeline on Kubernetes (EKS), cutting deployment time from 45 minutes to 4 minutes. Designed an event-driven retry system using Kafka that reduced failed-order incidents by 80%. Mentored two junior engineers through their first on-call rotations.

### Software Engineer, DataFlow Inc (2019-2022)
Built a real-time analytics pipeline processing 2M events/day using Apache Flink and Cassandra. Owned the on-call rotation for the payments service, cutting P1 incident resolution time in half by writing automated runbooks.

## Skills
Python, Go, Kubernetes, Kafka, Terraform, PostgreSQL, AWS (EKS, RDS, S3).

## Education
B.S. Computer Science, University of Washington, 2019.

# Marcus Chen

## Summary
Product manager with 5 years of experience shipping consumer-facing features, focused on growth and experimentation.

## Experience

### Senior Product Manager, Northwind Retail (2021-Present)
Led a cross-functional launch of a personalized recommendation carousel that grew to 40% of daily active users within two quarters, coordinating with 3 engineering teams and 2 designers. Ran a checkout-flow pricing experiment that showed no statistically significant lift; the post-mortem led the team to redesign the experiment framework to require a minimum sample size before shipping.

### Product Manager, Bright Path Learning (2019-2021)
Owned the onboarding funnel for a subscription education app, increasing trial-to-paid conversion from 8% to 14% through five iterative A/B tests. Wrote the product requirements for the mobile app's offline mode, coordinating with engineering and QA across two platforms.

## Skills
SQL, Figma, Amplitude, A/B testing, roadmap planning, stakeholder management.

## Education
B.A. Economics, University of Michigan, 2019.

# Sofia Alvarez

## Summary
Data scientist with 4 years of experience building production ML models for consumer retention and experimentation.

## Experience

### Data Scientist, Loop Finance (2022-Present)
Built a churn-prediction model using gradient-boosted trees that improved 90-day retention by 12% when its risk scores were used to trigger targeted retention offers. Designed the company's A/B testing infrastructure, including a sequential-testing library that let teams stop experiments early without inflating false-positive rates.

### Data Analyst, Loop Finance (2020-2022)
Built the weekly cohort-retention dashboard used by the executive team, replacing a manual spreadsheet process that took two days to update. Partnered with the growth team to design and analyze 15+ pricing experiments.

## Skills
Python, scikit-learn, SQL, dbt, pandas, experiment design.

## Education
M.S. Statistics, Carnegie Mellon University, 2020.

# Senior Backend Engineer — CloudScale Systems

## About the Role
We are hiring a Senior Backend Engineer to help scale our distributed order-processing platform. You'll work on infrastructure that handles millions of transactions per day.

## Responsibilities
Design and operate Kubernetes-based services running on AWS EKS. Participate in an on-call rotation and lead incident response for production outages. Mentor junior engineers and review infrastructure-as-code changes.

## Requirements
5+ years of backend engineering experience. Deep experience with Kubernetes and container orchestration in production. Experience with event-driven architectures such as Kafka. Strong incident-response and debugging skills under pressure.

## Nice to Have
Experience with Terraform, exposure to Go, prior ownership of a payments or order-processing system.
